Facebook.reason: needs the page token this operation is not allowed to touch; coordinated_social_publish posts through it

Tumblr.reason: needs OAuth for the stats endpoint; the publisher posts through it and the count stays unknown

blogPageviews.why: Google Analytics is not installed and may not be installed during the publisher review, and Blogger exposes no pageview API - so only search traffic can be counted, from Search Console

note: followers per post is the honest reach test: it is what a published post has historically converted into on that network
